agent_brief: GBP suspended about 4 weeks ago. Service areas conflict between Gold Coast, Brisbane and Tweed Coast. No street address anywhere on the site. Phone number on GBP does not match the website footer. Several footer links 404.
headline: Your Google listing is suspended. Right now you don't exist on Maps.
intro: Not ranking badly. Not ranking low. Gone. Every "leaking shower repair near me" search in Brisbane is being answered by someone else, and it stays that way until the profile is reinstated. Your website is still live and still ranking, which means the recovery has something to build on.
loss_bullets: Your listing in the Google Maps local pack — the three results above everything else
Every review you have earned, hidden from public view
Your business on Google Maps when someone searches your name
Direction requests, click-to-call and message buttons
Local pack visibility for all eight of your services

suspension_causes.evidence: Site lists 'Gold Coast / Brisbane / Brisbane South' on the homepage and 'Tweed Coast' on the contact page
suspension_causes.fix: Settle on one service area that matches the profile exactly, and make every page on the site agree with it.

suspension_causes.evidence: No physical address on the site, in the footer, or on the contact page
suspension_causes.fix: Publish a verifiable address in the footer of every page — this is the single most common trigger for a service-area business suspension.

suspension_causes.evidence: GBP shows 0407 xxx xxx, website footer shows 07 5xxx xxxx
suspension_causes.fix: Standardise one number across the profile, the website and every directory listing.

suspension_causes.evidence: Four links in the site footer return 404, including 'Our Guarantee'
suspension_causes.fix: Repair or remove them before the reinstatement request is filed.

existing_strengths: A live WordPress site that is indexed and ranking organically
Individual service pages for all eight services
A photo gallery of completed jobs with genuine before and after shots
Current QBCC licence documentation available for verification

phases.title: Reinstatement
phases.focus: Remove every reason Google had to suspend the profile, then file the appeal with the evidence it asks for.
steps: Publish a verifiable street address across the site
Reconcile service areas so the site and the profile state the same thing
Standardise the phone number everywhere it appears
Repair the four broken footer links
Compile licence and premises evidence, then file the reinstatement request

phases.title: Ranking expansion
phases.focus: Once the profile is back, build the signals that decide whether you sit at position one or position seven in the local pack.
steps: Weekly Google Posts covering each service
Review generation flow after every completed job
Photo uploads geotagged to the service area
Citation building across trade directories with consistent details

guarantees: We guarantee the reinstatement request is prepared correctly, submitted, and appealed as many times as Google permits.
We cannot guarantee Google reinstates a profile. That decision is theirs alone and no agency can commit to it.
If the profile is not reinstated within the term, the ranking work on your website continues at no additional cost.

pricing_tiers.name: Recovery
pricing_tiers.tagline: Get the profile back and hold the core area
features: Full profile audit and evidence pack
Site corrections that caused the suspension

pricing_tiers.name: Recovery & Reach
pricing_tiers.tagline: Reinstatement plus the wider Brisbane radius

payment_terms: One-time payment. Nothing recurring, no lock-in contract.
closing_note: Every week the profile stays down is roughly A$1,560 of work going to the three businesses currently sitting where you used to. The reinstatement request takes about a week to prepare properly, and it can only be filed once the site corrections are live.
disclaimer: Findings are based on publicly available information at the time of writing. Reinstatement decisions are made solely by Google and cannot be guaranteed by any third party. Suspension causes are assessed from observable evidence; Google does not disclose its reasons.
